title: pathology-data-mining/mussel-nf pipeline parameters
description: pipeline for running Mussel to extract features and build a reef

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

hf_cache_dir.description: Shared Hugging Face cache for model weights, on a filesystem every task can see; each model is downloaded once and the directory is bound into Apptainer/Docker containers. Set with --hf_cache_dir, -params-file or a profile (not a -c config). Unset: a per-task cache (re-downloads every model in every task).

profile_dir.description: Opt-in task profiling: Mussel tasks sample their GPU, record start/end times and write Mussel's per-stage timings (timings_path) under <profile_dir>/<task hash>/ with task.json and their .command.log (bin/summarize_task_profiles.py).

publish_mode.description: mode used to publish output files

samples_csv.description: samples csv file with slides to process

samples_csv_watch_path.description: watch this path for sample csv files

watch_path.description: watch this path for sample svs files

publish_slide_prefix.description: include first 4 digits of the slide ID in the publish dir

scratch_dir.description: Path to fast local scratch storage for WSI caching (e.g., /scratch/$USER). When set, input WSI files are staged to this directory before processing.

test_data_dir.description: Path to slide files used by test profiles (test_multi_slide). Ignored in normal runs.

use_one_step_workflow.description: Use one-step tessellation and featurization workflow
use_one_step_workflow.help_text: When true, uses TESSELLATE_FEATURIZE_BATCH for combined tessellation and feature extraction. When false, uses separate TESSELLATE and FEATURIZE_BATCH processes.

tessellate_only.description: Run tessellation only and skip feature extraction
tessellate_only.help_text: When true, emits tile H5 outputs and manifests without running feature extraction, linear probe, CLIP, or WDS steps.

filter_model_type.description: Patch encoder used to extract features for legacy tile filtering (e.g. ctranspath).

filter_model_path.description: Path to the .pkl sklearn classifier used by legacy tile filtering.

filter_threshold.description: Confidence threshold for the legacy tile classifier (0–1). Tiles below this score are discarded.

filter_tiles.description: Enable legacy classifier-based tile filtering. After tessellation, extracts patch features with filter_model_type and applies a .pkl classifier to discard non-tissue tiles.

seg_config_group.help_text: Use a predefined segmentation configuration: 'default', 'biopsy', 'resection', or 'tcga'. When null, uses individual segmentation parameters.

patch_size.description: Explicit tile size (pixels at mpp) for every model. Default null: each model is tiled at its recommended size (assets/recommended_patch_sizes.json, from Mussel's MODEL_PATCH_SIZES), with one tessellation per distinct size. Prefer featurize.model_patch_sizes for per-model overrides.

mpp.description: Tile resolution (µm/px) for every model. Default (null): each model's authors' resolution (target_mpp in assets/recommended_patch_sizes.json), else 0.5. Prefer featurize.model_mpps for one model.

overlap.description: Patch overlap in pixels. Default 0 (no overlap). Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

min_tissue_proportion.description: Minimum fraction of a patch that must be tissue to be retained. Default 0.0 (keep all). Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

remove_artifacts.description: Use GrandQC neural artifact remover to exclude artifact regions from the tissue mask during tessellation. Does not require a separate classifier model. Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

remove_penmarks.description: Detect and exclude pen mark regions before tessellation. Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

seg_model.description: Tissue segmentation model used during tessellation: classic (HSV + fixed threshold), otsu (HSV + Otsu automatic threshold), or neural (DeepLabV3 neural network). If unset, Mussel uses its own default (classic) or the seg_config_group preset value. Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

neural_seg_max_tiles.description: Maximum 512x512 inference tiles for neural tissue segmentation. Set to 0 to disable the guard for validated large-slide cohorts.

slide_mpp_override.description: If set, use this value (µm/px) as the slide's native MPP instead of reading from slide metadata. Use when a slide lacks MPP tags and the metadata-based fallback produces incorrect results.

workflow_batch_size.description: tiling.workflow_batch_size: number of slides grouped into one TESSELLATE task. Conservative batching reduces scheduler overhead.

model_types.description: models to use for feature extraction

items.description: Patch encoders: resnet50, ctranspath, gigapath, virchow, virchow2, optimus, hoptimus1, h0mini, uni, uni2h, conch1_5, conch_v1, clip, googlepath, phikon, phikon_v2, midnight12k, gpfm, hibou_l, openmidnight, genbio_pathfm, kaiko_vits8, kaiko_vits16, kaiko_vitb8, kaiko_vitb16, kaiko_vitl14, lunit_vits8, lunit_vits16, musk, keep. Slide encoders: gigapath_slide, titan_slide, prism_slide, feather_slide, chief_slide, madeleine_slide, abmil_slide.

use_gpu.description: use the GPU for feature extraction

batch_size.description: Batch size for tile/patch feature extraction

workflow_batch_size.description: featurize.workflow_batch_size: number of slides grouped into a single feature-extraction task. Reduces scheduler overhead.

slide_batch_size.description: Number of slides to process together in a batch (controls both Type 2 and Type 3 batching)

slide_max_patches.description: TITAN: aggregate at most this many tiles per slide, a subset seeded by the slide's file name (Mussel extract_features max_slide_patches, Mussel #151). Null or 0 keeps every tile. Caps TITAN's memory on very large slides; patch features are still written for every tile.

max_tiles_per_sample.description: Multi-slide: maximum number of tiles to keep per sample after concatenation. Null keeps all tiles.

subsampling_strategy.description: Multi-slide: tile subsampling strategy when max_tiles_per_sample is set.

subsampling_seed.description: Multi-slide: random seed for subsampling reproducibility.

tile_size_check.description: Mussel tile_size_check for each model: 'error' fails when a model's tiles aren't its recommended size/MPP; models overridden on purpose get 'warn'. null omits the option (Mussel without tile_size_check).

model_mpps.description: Explicit per-model resolution overrides (µm/px), e.g. {"chief_slide": 0.5}. Takes precedence over tiling.mpp and the model's target resolution.

grid_from_primary.description: Models whose tiles are derived from the primary (first model's) tiles instead of tessellated at their own size: every cell of the model's tile size containing a primary tile centre, at the primary resolution. E.g. ["titan_slide"] builds TITAN's 512 px grid from the 224 px tiles. Two-step workflow only.

multi_model_patch_pass.description: Two-step workflow: run all plain patch models that share a tile set (size and resolution) in one task, reading each tile once. Needs Mussel with extract_features model_types (Mussel#144).

model_patch_sizes.description: Explicit per-model tile size overrides (pixels at the model's resolution), e.g. {"conch1_5": 448}. Takes precedence over tiling.patch_size and the recommended size.

model_batch_sizes.description: Per-model batch sizes for feature extraction. Keys are model names (e.g., ctranspath, optimus), values are integers. If not specified, uses default batch_size.

save_features_to_h5.description: Save patch-level features to HDF5 (.h5) in addition to .pt slide tensors.

embedding_precision.description: Numeric dtype used when saving extracted feature embeddings. 'float32' preserves full precision; 'float16'/'bfloat16' halve storage size. Note: multi-slide sample aggregation (MERGE_SAMPLE_FEATURES) with non-float32 precision is currently unsupported.

model_precision_overrides.description: Per-model embedding precision overrides. Takes precedence over embedding_precision. Keys are model type names (e.g. 'optimus'), values are 'float32', 'float16', or 'bfloat16'.

benchmark_precisions.description: Precision variants to generate for linear probe benchmarking. A CPU-only conversion step casts existing float32 features to each listed precision and feeds all variants into the linear probe workflow. Designed for use with embedding_precision='float32'.

slide_to_patch_mapping.description: Maps slide-level encoder names to the required patch encoder.

model_types.description: models that are designated as CLIP-based

default_classes.description: default classes to use for prompt-engineering

oncotree_class_csv.description: mapping of oncotree codes to classes to use for prompt-engineering

annotations_csv.description: mapping of slide IDs to annotation bmp file

annotation_class_mapping_yaml.description: Optional YAML mapping BMP pixel values to remapped class IDs. When omitted, raw non-zero BMP pixel values are used directly as class labels.

cv.description: Cross-validation folds for GridSearchCV hyperparameter tuning

C_values.description: Regularisation strengths to search in GridSearchCV

penalties.description: Penalty types to search in GridSearchCV (l1, l2, elasticnet, none)

n_seeds.description: Number of random seeds; mean +/- std reported across seeds

n_bootstrap.description: Bootstrap resamples for 95% CI on test AUC-ROC (primary seed)

positive_annotation_label.description: Annotation value treated as the positive class. Default 1 for class-mapped 0/1 annotations; set to 2 for raw (unmapped) BMP annotation values.

random_state.description: Random seed for linear probe cross-validation.

multiclass.description: Enable multiclass mode (>=3 classes) for linear probe benchmarking.

abmil_benchmark.title: ABMIL benchmark options
abmil_benchmark.description: Train a Gated-ABMIL classifier on per-slide H5 features and report AUROC. Runs automatically when labels_parquet and target_col are set.

labels_parquet.description: Parquet file with columns: slide_id, <target_col>, and optionally a split column.

split_col.description: Optional column containing pre-defined 'train'/'val'/'test' split labels. When null, a random slide-level split is used.

n_seeds.description: Number of random seeds; mean +/- std reported across seeds.

n_bootstrap.description: Bootstrap resamples for 95% CI on test AUROC (primary seed only).

batch_size.description: Slides per batch. Tiles are zero-padded to the longest slide in the batch.

head_dim.description: Hidden dimension for each ABMIL attention head.

n_heads.description: Number of independent attention heads in ABMIL.

dtype.description: Dtype to cast features to at load time. Use float16 or bfloat16 to simulate low-precision storage and measure impact on AUROC.

test_size.description: Fraction of slides held out as test set (only used when split_col is null).

val_size.description: Fraction of slides held out as validation set (only used when split_col is null).

wds.title: WebDataset sharding options
wds.description: Pack per-slide feature files into WebDataset-compatible .tar shards

enabled.description: Enable WebDataset shard output. When true, per-slide .pt (and optionally .h5) feature files are collected and packed into .tar shards after extraction.

group_by_oncotree.description: When true, produce separate shard sets per oncotree_code from the sample sheet. Requires oncotree_code column in samples_csv. When false, all slides are sharded together under the group 'all'.

shard_h5.description: Extract tile coordinates from .h5 patch-feature files and store as .coords.npy in the shard alongside .features.npy. Note: .h5 files are large.

max_shard_size.description: Maximum number of slides per .tar shard.

shard_prefix.description: Filename prefix for shard tar files. Default '' produces 000000.tar (paladin-compatible naming).

download.title: GDC slide download options
download.description: Settings for the DOWNLOAD_SLIDE process, which fetches TCGA slides via gdc-client when slides are not yet on disk or S3.

local_dir.description: Root directory where downloaded slides are cached. Files land at <local_dir>/<file_id>/<file_name>. Shared across pipeline runs via storeDir.

gdc_token_file.description: Path to GDC user token file for controlled-access data. Leave empty for open-access TCGA slides.

n_connections.description: Number of parallel connections per gdc-client download invocation.

gdc_client_bin.description: Path or name of the gdc-client binary.

max_concurrent.description: Max parallel DOWNLOAD_SLIDE tasks per batch (maxForks).

jitter_seconds.description: Random sleep 0-N seconds before gdc-client to stagger API calls.
